Manage dashboards

:::tip[Learn more]
The Bronto docs explain the platform concept behind this command: [docs.bronto.io/Search-and-Visualize/Dashboards](https://docs.bronto.io/Search-and-Visualize/Dashboards)
:::

```sh
bronto dashboards <command> [flags]
```

#### Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`bronto dashboards attach-widgets`](/reference/commands/dashboards/#bronto-dashboards-attach-widgets) | Attach widgets to a dashboard |
| [`bronto dashboards create`](/reference/commands/dashboards/#bronto-dashboards-create) | Create a dashboard |
| [`bronto dashboards delete`](/reference/commands/dashboards/#bronto-dashboards-delete) | Delete a dashboard |
| [`bronto dashboards detach-from-template`](/reference/commands/dashboards/#bronto-dashboards-detach-from-template) | Detach a dashboard from its template |
| [`bronto dashboards get`](/reference/commands/dashboards/#bronto-dashboards-get) | Get a dashboard by ID |
| [`bronto dashboards list`](/reference/commands/dashboards/#bronto-dashboards-list) | List dashboards |
| [`bronto dashboards remove-widget`](/reference/commands/dashboards/#bronto-dashboards-remove-widget) | Remove a widget from a dashboard |
| [`bronto dashboards update`](/reference/commands/dashboards/#bronto-dashboards-update) | Update a dashboard |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

## bronto dashboards attach-widgets

Attach widgets to a dashboard

```sh
bronto dashboards attach-widgets <dashboard> --widget-ids <id,...> [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--widget-ids` |  | strings |  | widget IDs to attach (comma-separated or repeated) |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

#### Examples

```sh
bronto dashboards attach-widgets <dashboard> --widget-ids <id>,<id>
```

## bronto dashboards create

Create a dashboard

```sh
bronto dashboards create [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--field` | `-f` | stringArray |  | request body field as key=value; values parse as JSON when possible (repeatable) |
| `--input` |  | string |  | read the request body from a file, or - for stdin |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

#### Examples

```sh
bronto dashboards create -f name=<name>
bronto dashboards create --input body.json
```
